human_authorization.request: validate these: selective application, accumulating knowledge, correcting knowledge, composition, useful compression, reliable action
human_authorization.scope: New bounded local DEV validation; no modification of old instruments or meta-test

measurement.accumulating: Stage 2 learns cobalt and retains previously correct amber; report acquisition prerequisite
measurement.actions: Exact full tool sequence and args, exact final string, exact entire filesystem snapshot, no execution error
measurement.battery_pass: All required cases on all three seeds; otherwise report partial counts and counterexamples, not full-study accept/refute
measurement.composition: Stage 2/3, both client orders, novel inputs; prerequisite component successes reported
measurement.compression: Exact paired behavior retained and total per-memory bytes below raw active teaching text; shared runtime excluded equally
measurement.correcting: Stage 3 learns replacement amber and retains previously correct cobalt; report acquisition prerequisite
measurement.scope: One explicit-context append-rule family, 4 held-out base words, 4 local tool tasks; no broad competence or promotion threshold
measurement.selective: Stage 1 amber and two unassigned clients; stage 2/3 each scope separately

system: Return only the answer string, with no explanation, label, or quotation marks. Each client has a separate string formatting preference learned from corrected examples. A client with no taught preference copies the input unchanged. A new correction replaces only that client's previous preference. For multiple clients, apply their preferences in the stated order to the whole string.

training.loss: Mean CE of three corrected examples plus EOS
